verdicts.reason: User asks for an appointment; bot greets and starts intake with a sensible first question.
User confirms first visit; bot moves on to ask what they need help with.
User describes their concern; bot takes it and moves to the next booking question.
Ignores the user: they clearly named a doctor, yet bot claims it did not catch that and re-asks.
Asks what was already answered: user repeated the doctor name and bot re-asks the same question again.
Invents an acknowledgement: user asked for a named doctor, bot responds as if they wanted a suggestion.
User gives day and time preference; bot offers matching Monday morning slots.
User picks the earliest Monday 10:00 slot; bot confirms exactly that slot.
